parent_objective: audit deterministic sentinel-filtered v4 sequence-outcome corpus export before objective design

public_gates: M756 verifies M755 positive corpus gates
M756 classifies hard-negative sparsity separately from corpus validity
M756 checks v4 metadata and claim-boundary preservation
M756 decides whether objective design is admissible
actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat hard-negative sparse corpus as complete contrast data
do not treat current-model/proxy faults as true single-wheel physics

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns M755 export result into a reviewed branch decision before objective work
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; may admit objective design but cannot claim policy improvement
stop_condition: stop if positive corpus gates fail
stop if v4 metadata or claim-boundary fields are missing
stop if hard-negative sparsity is ignored
stop if audit admits PPO or promotion directly
fallback_plan: if corpus is clean but hard negatives are sparse, decide whether objective can use positives-only preference first
if metadata is missing, repair exporter before objective design
if source concentration dominates, design fresh holdout or repeat export
if claim boundary is insufficient, pivot to four-wheel/high-fidelity simulator planning

hypothesis: M755 is a clean positive v4 corpus export with sparse hard negatives and can admit a constrained objective-design branch after audit.
success_criteria: M756 reviews positive corpus gates and hard-negative sparsity
M756 records supported and falsified claims
M756 classifies residual risks and failure taxonomy
M756 chooses the next branch before objective training PPO or promotion
failure_criteria: audit treats sparse hard negatives as complete
audit claims trained policy improvement from exported data
audit admits PPO or promotion without objective sanity gates
decision_rule: M756 may only audit M755 and choose the next branch. It must not run objective training PPO actor updates or checkpoint promotion.
